decides: 향후 수요 성장 대비 자원이 충분하며 언제 증설해야 하는가
produces: capacity forecast, expansion trigger thresholds, cost note

record_spec.gate_c_axis_evaluation: see docs/handbooks/architecture-methodology.md, section 'Axis evaluation procedure — external_burden' for the READ/EXECUTE/CRITERIA/CITATION method this role's axis_evaluation entries must follow: EXECUTE resolves resource, recomputes verdict from the record's own demand_forecast against capacity_threshold, and checks whether the reviewed artifact adds unaccounted new demand, per the ITIL Capacity Management practice (https://www.itlibrary.org/).

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed from the current demand_forecast against capacity_threshold, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: resource must resolve to an actual monitored resource — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2). Each axis_evaluation ref must resolve to a real entry inside this record carrying axis (must be in this role's judgment_axes), verdict (supports|contradicts|no-opinion), and citation (a docs/product/*.md entry path); when verdict is contradicts, the entry must also carry a finding object with target_path (must resolve against some role's write_scope) and a non-empty required_fix (issue-573 architecture proposal, sections 1 and 6).

use_when.board_condition: projected demand for a resource is reassessed AND no capacity-planning record exists yet for that resource

use_when: 용량 예측/증설 시점 결정이 걸릴 때
